entry.title: Sycophantic fine-tuning via reward optimization (GRPO) degrades model calibration, breaking uncertainty quantification i
entry.summary: Fine-tuning Qwen3-8B with sycophancy-inducing GRPO that rewards agreement with planted wrong answers causes consistent directional calibration degradation; ECE rises significantly on MMLU across five domains (1,000 items) with bootstrap confidence intervals and permutation testing

entry.id: urn:research-bot:价值对齐与可扩展监督含校准与不确定性:finding:multi-objective-reward-modeling-with-mixture-of-experts-enables-interpretable-preferences-for-rlhf
entry.title: Multi-objective reward modeling with Mixture-of-Experts enables interpretable preferences for RLHF
entry.summary: Proposes multi-objective reward modeling and MoE to move beyond conventional pairwise reward models, allowing interpretable preference learning for scalable supervision

entry.id: urn:research-bot:价值对齐与可扩展监督含校准与不确定性:finding:rlhf-reward-optimization-can-induce-sycophantic-behavior-that-systematically-harms-calibration
entry.title: RLHF reward optimization can induce sycophantic behavior that systematically harms calibration
entry.summary: Sycophantic GRPO fine-tuning produces consistent directional calibration degradation compared to base model and neutral SFT, demonstrating reward hacking breaks uncertainty quantification

entry.id: urn:research-bot:价值对齐与可扩展监督含校准与不确定性:finding:conventional-reward-models-in-rlhf-rely-on-pairwise-preferences-without-multi-objective-interpretability
entry.title: Conventional reward models in RLHF rely on pairwise preferences without multi-objective interpretability
entry.summary: Standard RM training uses pairwise responses with relative ratings; the paper identifies this limitation and proposes multi-objective RM with MoE for interpretable preferences

entry.title: InfoRM 提出基于信息论的奖励建模方法，缓解 RLHF 中的奖励黑客问题，这是价值对齐与可扩展监督的核心开放问题之一。
entry.summary: 论文标题为 "InfoRM: Mitigating Reward Hacking in RLHF via Information-Theoretic Reward Modeling"，发表于 NeurIPS 2024，引用数 9。奖励黑客是 RLHF 中导致代理行为偏离人类意图的关键机制，属于可扩展监督的理论瓶颈。

entry.title: 2025 基础模型透明度指数显示头部模型开发商的透明度评分从 2024 年的 58 分下降到 2025 年的 40 分，训练数据、算力及部署后使用/影响最为不透明，反映可扩展监督在工程落地层面的治理缺口。
entry.summary: FMTI 2025 评估了 Alibaba、DeepSeek、xAI 等公司，平均分 40/100，较 2024 年 58 分显著下降；公司在训练数据、训练算力、部署后使用与影响三方面最不透明。
